The outline is a dark brown, tinted toward the wood, so it is not a black sticker line. The branches are tiny, sparse stubs, so the form is much thinner and simpler than the references. Even the simpler reference tree-1a786c has a clustered, multi-tone trunk and root flare, and tree-d43edd has gnarled roots and branches with many tones. A careful artist would not accept this next to them, since it looks thinner, flatter and more sticker-like. A dead snag may be sparse, but it should still carry bark texture and 5-6 wood tones.
